description: Default architecture, no weight assignment (random init, expected ~0% accuracy).

Hypothesis enumeration: attention gathers prompt digits; 50 candidate lines (m,b) are AND-tested against each point, the consistent line is evaluated at xq. No LayerNorm, 4 layers, d_model=267, d_ff=1000.

Hypothesis enumeration in 3 blocks: attention gathers prompt digits; AND-units test 50 candidate lines (m,b) against each point; a 4-way AND with xq and the position flag writes the digits of m*xq+b. No LayerNorm, d_model=217, d_ff=1000.
Same 3-block hypothesis-enumeration circuit as LinInterp3Layer, but the constant query comes from the sum of the position one-hot instead of a CONST dim (d_model=216).
NoConst variant with the position one-hot trimmed to positions 0..12 (the only ones ever read, since the answer is read at positions 11 and 12); d_model=213.
4 blocks: gather digits; AND-test 50 lines against each point; AND with xq writes the answer value into a 55-dim one-hot VAL block; digit extraction gated by position. d_model=268, d_ff=1000.
ValueBlock circuit with the gather-attention score margin reduced to 3 (from 30) to test how sharp the attention must be.
ValueBlock circuit with the gather-attention score margin reduced to 10 (from 30) to test how sharp the attention must be.
ValueBlock circuit with the gather-attention score margin reduced to 6 (from 30) to test how sharp the attention must be.
ValueBlock circuit with the gather-attention score margin reduced to 4 (from 30) to test how sharp the attention must be.
ValueBlock circuit with attention keys trimmed to d_head=11 (positions 0..10 only; score margin back at 30); d_model=268 unchanged.
ValueBlock circuit (d_head=11) with per-block MLP widths [1, 1000, 500, 16] instead of 1000 everywhere; the unused MLP units of the later blocks are no longer allocated.

5 blocks: each point's digits are first merged into a 55-dim value one-hot; then the per-point line tests, the xq-AND into the answer value, and digit extraction. d_model=378, per-block d_ff [1,110,1000,500,16].
PerPoint 5-block circuit with every MLP bias removed: each threshold is a weight from a constant-1 residual dimension (CONST). d_model=379.
NoBias 5-block circuit with the gather-attention score margin set to 5 (from 30); sweep point between the failing 4 and passing 6.
NoBias 5-block circuit with the gather-attention score margin set to 8 (from 30); sweep point.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30) with i.i.d. Gaussian noise sigma=0.05 added to every parameter after the hand-written weights are set.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30) with i.i.d. Gaussian noise sigma=0.01 added to every parameter after the hand-written weights are set.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30) with i.i.d. Gaussian noise sigma=0.003 added to every parameter after the hand-written weights are set.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, no noise) with the causal attention mask removed: tests that the circuit does not depend on masking.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, no noise) with GELU in place of ReLU in the MLPs: tests sensitivity of the exact ReLU threshold circuit to the activation.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, no noise) with a parameter-free LayerNorm before each attention and MLP: tests whether the exact circuit survives normalization.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, no noise) with one extra, all-zero attention head (8 heads): padding invariance check.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, causal mask, no noise) with 16 extra unused residual dimensions (d_model=395): padding invariance check.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, causal mask, no noise) plus one extra, all-zero residual block (6 blocks): depth-padding invariance check.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, causal mask, no noise) with attention keys widened to d_head=13 (all position dims); checks that the key width does not matter.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, causal mask, no noise) with the output-block weights scaled by 0.1: checks that argmax decoding is scale-invariant.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, causal mask, no noise) with the gather value vectors halved (W_v = 0.5): tests how sensitive the thresholds are to activation scale.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, causal mask, no noise) with AND thresholds shifted to -1.4 (2-way) and -2.4 (3-way): tests the tolerance of the AND units.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, causal mask) with i.i.d. Gaussian noise sigma=0.001 added to every parameter after the hand-written weights are set.
NoBias 5-block circuit (canonical margin 30, causal mask, no noise) with AND thresholds set too low (-0.6 2-way, -1.6 3-way): a negative control for the margin results.
